description: the same permissions as `default`, for the one origin a developer loads instead of the bundle: the Next dev server that `tauri dev` opens through `build.devUrl`. A released build loads its interface from disk and never reaches this origin, so this capability is not part of it: .github/workflows/release.yml overrides app.security.capabilities with `["default"]`, and a build that does not name a capability set enables every file in this directory. `https://*.vercel.app` used to be here for shells built against a preview deployment through MIXTURE_DESKTOP_URL; that build mode is gone, and with it a wildcard that matched every preview of every Vercel account.
